messages:
Anya (partnerships): quick sync — AtlasCloud asked for a documented SEV path we can share with their support + SRE. want to nail shared channel names, who gets paged, and war room ownership.
Mike (eng-sre): +1. do we want a single matrix or per-product flows?
Anya (partnerships): single canonical matrix with a small appendix for Dedicated vs Hosted. keep it simple.
Jordan (support): from support side we need clear handoff triggers. examples: 1) customer reports API 500s on atlas-integrated deployment 2) model mismatch/regression for a customer deployment 3) billing/usage anomaly.
Helen (sales): also include a contact for contract/SI questions — Atlas will loop in their account mgrs.
Ravi (engineering): for runtime incidents (latency/oom) we probably want eng-sre oncall + atlas on-call alias in the war room. can we standardize war room channel name?
Anya (partnerships): proposal: #atlas-war-<org>-<sev> for active warrooms and a persistent shared channel #atlas-support-liaison for async ops. thoughts?
Mike (eng-sre): naming looks good. add retention for logs: war rooms ephemeral (30d), liaison persistent.
Atlas PM: atlas ok with #atlas-war-{customer}-{sev}. we need to be explicit about data sharing: they want logs but not full request payloads.
Jordan (support): suggestion for handoff message template (short):
```
Handoff: SEV2 / latency
Customer: acme-inc
Impact: 20% failed requests
Initial actions: route to atlas-war-acme-sev2, notify eng-sre oncall, start perf trace
Required from Atlas: topology + recent autoscale events
```
Ravi (engineering): add kv cache sequence IDs + model version to requests we ask for. saves time.
Mike (eng-sre): who owns the war room coordinator role? my suggestion: first 30 minutes — Redwood oncall + Atlas tech lead. after 30m if still active, rotate to joint postmortem owner.
Anya (partnerships): agree. I'll draft an Owner/Roles section: Initiator (Support) -> Coordinator (Redwood oncall + Atlas tech lead) -> Escalation (separately mapped to Eng Lead / Partner CS).
ops-bot: created channel #atlas-support-liaison (private) and #atlas-war-acme-sev2 (ephemeral)
Helen (sales): please add legal-approved phrasing for logs/data access. I can loop legal in draft.
Jordan (support): one more operational ask: include an explicit 'abort/mitigate-only' checklist so partners know when we won't escalate to SEV. keeps noise down.
Anya (partnerships): good call. I'll put together a short doc and post in #atlas-support-liaison. will also attach a 1-page PDF for Atlas partners with flow diagram.
Mike (eng-sre): after doc is drafted let's run a tabletop with Atlas and Support — 30-45 min. recommend we record and collect action items.
Atlas PM: ok to schedule tabletop next week. thanks.
Anya (partnerships): thanks all — I'll share draft by EOD tomorrow and ping for tabletop times. :white_check_mark:
Mike (eng-sre): :thumbsup:
